results_produced: none. Only a 960-timestep, one-root smoke exists; it must not be interpreted. No seed produced result.json.
root_cause_on_my_side: I adapted my v2 runner to four arms and launched it, instead of implementing the frozen contract. Speed of execution was traded against fidelity to the design, and the design is the point.
successor_requirements_before_any_freeze: three kappa cells including the iid null at 0.50
the retained structured controller as an arm, so the neural premium is computable
the service ledger reported as mandatory secondary disclosures
real checkpoint selection on the selection split only
total timesteps, PPO hyperparameters, checkpoint cadence and bar-root count frozen IN the contract, not chosen at the command line
the static bar computed once over the whole selection split and written before grading
a development-opening receipt written when the roots are opened
fresh roots and fresh optimizer seeds
an execution environment that can attest its commit and a clean worktree
verification: every finding above was checked against the runner and the contract in this lineage, not accepted on assertion

verified_findings.1_bar_roots: contract declares 16 selection roots (7662101-7662116); the run used --bar-roots 4 and the smoke used 1
verified_findings.2_runtime_not_frozen: the contract fixes neither total timesteps, nor PPO hyperparameters, nor checkpoint cadence, nor the number of roots used for the bar (verified: no 'timesteps' or 'learning_rate' key in training_protocol)
verified_findings.3_sharding_after_freeze: --seed-indices was added, rsynced and launched before the commit documenting it
verified_findings.4_vps_not_attestable: the VPS working copy has no .git, so no execution commit or clean worktree can be attested
verified_findings.5_kappa_null_missing: runner KAPPAS = (0.75, 0.90); the contract declares three cells including iid_null 0.50, so the iid null and the full dose response were not evaluable
verified_findings.6_no_retained_mpc: zero references to the structured comparator; the neural premium, which is the north star of the design, was not computable
verified_findings.7_no_checkpoint_selection: one final model is trained and selection_mean_ret computed afterwards; no selection among checkpoints occurs
verified_findings.8_no_service_ledger: zero references to worst_product_fill, unresolved_orders or lost_orders; the mandatory secondary disclosures were absent
verified_findings.9_no_opening_receipt: no development-opening receipt was written and the freeze receipt still asserts training_roots_opened=false while they were opened

who_stopped_it: the Codex lineage stopped the VPS processes, which also explains the SIGTERM I was diagnosing as a system watchdog. Given the findings, that was correct enforcement, not interference.
